items.evidence: The Compensation Committee selected adjusted EPS and cash flow generation as the absolute measures upon which to base the financial portion of our NEOs' annual cash incentive payout opportunity
The Compensation Committee approved a cash flow generation metric to align our executives' short-term incentive compensation with our publicly-stated goal
Our NEOs' key personal objectives are approved early in the fiscal year.
Our selection of ROCE as a performance metric for our #PSUs is also consistent with our strategic priorities.
Our selection of free cash flow as a [w] of cumulative net income converted as the performance metric for the #FCF Conversion PSUs is also part of our goal
The Board also approved a #-year relative TSR modifier that applies to all #ROCE PSUs and #FCF Conversion PSUs.
